title: ProSMoS — protein secondary-structure motif search engine
description:
ProSMoS (Protein Secondary structure Motif Search) searches the Protein Data Bank for proteins whose secondary-structure topology matches a user-supplied meta-matrix of interactions between secondary-structure elements — parallel or antiparallel pairing, handedness of connections, element lengths and hydrogen bonds — rather than by superposition of 3D coordinates.

This is a hardened, source-available working copy of the original ProSMoS release by Shuoyong Shi (UT Southwestern, ~2010), whose notes are preserved verbatim in readme.original. This tree adds defect fixes, a build system, a hardened meta-matrix database reader, and loop inversion in the search path; the copyright in the underlying work is unchanged and this repository claims only the modifications (see NOTICE.md). It is the search engine used by Schaeffer, Guo, Cong & Grishin, A topology census of four-strand β-sheets in experimental and predicted protein structures; the analysis for that paper is deposited separately under CC BY 4.0 and contains none of this code.

Released under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. This is source-available, not open source — a license restricting commercial use fails clause 6 of the Open Source Definition.
